choices.why: This light grey three-seat sofa has slim arms and wooden legs, and at 234 cm it suits the long left wall without overwhelming it.
A large 170x240 cream rug defines the seating area, brightens the grey-toned floor and feels cozy for guests.
The light ash coffee table with tapered legs is exactly the light wood piece requested and keeps the look airy and modern.
A long, low cream console with open shelves fits across from the sofa and blends with the white walls, keeping the room bright.
The black arc lamp reaches over the sofa from the corner, its black finish echoes the balcony door frame, and its warm drum shade softens the evening light.
Cream cushions with small colorful geometric accents add the requested touch of color while staying soft against the light grey sofa.
A tall areca palm by the balcony door adds height, greenery and a fresh feel in the brightest spot of the room.
A pair of white sheer curtains softens the wide black-framed sliding door while letting plenty of light in.

answer.why: A palette of light grey, cream and pale ash keeps the living room bright and modern, the black arc lamp picks up the black door frame, and the palm and colorful cushions bring in life and color for having friends over.
